title: Energy Crisis Here To Stay; This Asset Triples | Clem Chambers
speaker: Clem Chambers

macro_themes.view: Markets are being driven by liquidity the government is pumping in; buy-and-hold riders are passengers on a curated trend.
Bond-yield panic signals the top is in; the government can and will cap yields (QE via Treasury buybacks), though the Fed likely waits until after the midterms.
The West must massively build out energy for AI; all energy sources will be in demand and get more expensive.

macro_themes.theme: Oil: volatile range, elevated for long
macro_themes.view: Hormuz will be mostly open within a year via siege/pipelines, but refilling storage keeps prices elevated for a long time.

macro_themes.theme: AI vs anti-AI tug of war
macro_themes.view: Markets swing daily between the AI trade and a defensive 'Contra' trade; whoever wins AI wins, which drives everything.
America going all-in for growth versus China is reflationary and good for asset prices.

calls.condition: Long-term: expects copper to double or triple over 10 years; mentions 30,000 (his own) and 40,000 (an expert's) as levels, units not stated.
calls.reason: Copper is the 'nervous system' of the AI and energy build-out, supply barely sufficient and mines slow to build; at the start of a boom-bubble-bust run.
calls.quote: copper are already at all time highs, but we'll double triple in the next 10 years... Oh, easy.

calls.condition: Would look to buy if gold falls to ~3500; otherwise sideways rest for 1-2 years.
calls.reason: Gold and silver had their initial boom-bubble-bust and will rest for another year or two before another (smaller) run; 3500 is his buy level.
calls.quote: 3500 it looks good to me but when it gets there see what it looks like... Gold long term will go that-a-way.

calls.condition: Chart target of ~7% only if the government did not intervene; he expects it will.
calls.reason: Contrarian: panic over yields means the peak is in; government can bend the curve and Bessent's TGA buybacks are effectively QE. Charts say 7% absent intervention.
calls.quote: the moment everybody's screaming, oh, my God, down they come... Hue and cry is a contra indicator.

calls.condition: Range breaks only on a geopolitical shift; long-term bias is 'elevated', not a rising target.
calls.reason: Volatile range-bound trade on Iran/Houthi headlines; Hormuz mostly open within a year, but storage refill and AI-driven energy demand keep prices elevated for a long time.
calls.quote: Prices are going to be elevated. They're not going to go back to the pre levels for quite a long time.

calls.instrument_quoted: US equities broadly (no index level quoted)
calls.reason: Liquidity, US all-in growth push and the AI build-out ('increase in tempo') are great for assets; his risk-on portfolio is back at all-time highs.
calls.quote: increase in tempo is going to be great for assets. Great for assets, you just have to be in them.
